dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature following a parabolic spline on the trailing edge from the posterior ridge to the distal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degree incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual convex arc originating from the dorsal cranial region transitioning toward the anterior.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle where the melon slope meets the dorsal margin of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular white lesions or punctate scars visible on the lateral flank and head region.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of small white speckles/spots across the dark pigmented dorsal and lateral surfaces.
